usgs2026Context.recyclingContext: USGS estimates about 140,000 kg of palladium and platinum were recovered globally from new and old scrap in 2025.
limitations: These are annual 2025 estimates published in MCS 2026, not live quotes, bids, asks, or executable prices.
USGS does not publish a comparable osmium price in the cited price row, so osmium remains unavailable rather than zero or inferred.

usgs2026Context.rightsBoundary: USGS-authored portions are U.S. Government work and generally public domain; underlying attributed price inputs may retain third-party rights and source terms. Attribution is retained and downstream reuse requires its own rights review.

methodology.role: Authoritative completed-month historical and comparison backbone for this Chamber.
methodology.alignment: Cross-metal ratios use only rows where both IMF series report the same completed month.
methodology.currentQuoteSeparation: Gold API indicative values are not appended to, substituted into, or compared as if they were IMF monthly observations.
methodology.reuseBoundary: The IMF workbook is attributed here; its commodity descriptions identify underlying benchmark sources, so downstream reuse should also review IMF copyright and third-party-content terms.

catalog.boundary: Product status is the reviewed state shown by Metals.io at the review clock; coming soon is not live, and unlisted is not inferred to be planned.

denomination.issuerStatement: One VNXAU token represents one gram of physical gold.
denomination.claimType: issuer statement, not independently reconstructed from chain data

ownershipAndStorage.issuerStatement: VNX describes direct ownership of LBMA-certified gold stored in segregated high-security storage in Liechtenstein.
ownershipAndStorage.claimType: issuer statement; source mapping or contract verification alone does not prove this claim

redemption.issuerStatement: Physical redemption may be requested in multiples of one kilogram, subject to the documented process and eligibility requirements.
redemption.claimType: issuer statement; operational constraints and delays may apply

priceDiscovery.issuerStatement: Approved trading venues serve as price-discovery venues; Metals.io says there is no formal peg to gold spot prices.
priceDiscovery.boundary: Current physical-gold indicative price and VNXAU token market price remain separate observations.

legacyVnxPlatformNotice.appliesTo: legacy vnx.li exchange platform operations, not a claim that the Metals.io VNXAU product is unlisted
legacyVnxPlatformNotice.note: The issuer notice clock is preserved literally as 18:00 CET. No UTC conversion is inferred.

operationalNotice.appliesTo: legacy vnx.li exchange platform operations, not a claim that the Metals.io VNXAU product is unlisted
operationalNotice.note: The issuer notice clock is preserved literally as 18:00 CET. No UTC conversion is inferred.

reserveAup.scope: Procedures address management assertions and enumerated token/custody records only as at the statement clock.
reserveAup.currentEtherlinkBackingReconciliation: not established by this dated report
reserveAup.distributionBoundary: The report states restricted-use and distribution conditions; this artifact links to and summarizes scope without republishing its tables.

boundaries.mapping: CoinGecko platform mappings associate an asset registry row with contract strings; they do not independently prove issuer identity, custody, backing, redemption, or legal rights.
boundaries.price: VNXAU market observations are token prices. They are not current physical-gold spot, an executable quote, or evidence of a formal peg.

coverage.topHolders: One bounded Blockscout page (maximum 50 rows), not a complete beneficial-owner registry.
coverage.latestTransfers: One bounded latest-transfer page (maximum 50 rows), not complete history.
coverage.identity: Addresses and optional explorer labels are address context only and are not asserted to identify a person or common owner.

contracts.boundary: Verified source and ABI names establish published code lineage and declared capabilities only; they do not prove that a capability was invoked, by whom, or with what legal effect.

coverage.state: Current TzKT indexed return for the historical KT1, not proof that tokens were never issued elsewhere or that all historical state is reconstructed here.
coverage.identity: The creator and other addresses are raw chain addresses, not asserted to identify a person or beneficial owner.
coverage.networkSeparation: Tezos FA2 state is not added to, reconciled with, or treated as the same supply as Etherlink ERC-20 state.

boundaries.addressIdentity: A chain address, explorer label, or creator address is context, not proof of a person, beneficial owner, or common control.
boundaries.registryMapping: CoinGecko and explorer mappings do not independently prove issuer identity, backing, custody, redemption, or legal rights.
boundaries.priceSeparation: Current indicative gold USD/troy-ounce values, IMF completed-month averages, and VNXAU token market prices are separate observations with different units and clocks.
boundaries.reserveScope: The dated 2025-12-31 AUP is not an audit or assurance opinion and does not specifically reconcile the later Etherlink deployment or historical Tezos KT1.
boundaries.networkSupply: Etherlink ERC-20 and Tezos FA2 states remain separate and are never added together or treated as one reconciled supply.
boundaries.contractCapability: Verified ABI capabilities are not evidence that an action occurred.
boundaries.noExecution: This dataset contains evidence and source references only; it provides no order, swap, wallet, purchase, or sale action.

clocks.goldApi: Independent provider updatedAt per metal; retrieval time remains separate.
clocks.imfPcps: Completed calendar month label, not a live timestamp.
clocks.usgs: 2025 estimated annual average published in MCS 2026.
clocks.vnxAup: Statement as at 2025-12-31, distinct from PDF retrieval and Etherlink launch.
clocks.chain: API observation/retrieval clock; returned bounded pages are not full historical reconstruction.

comparisons.historicalBackbone: IMF PCPS completed-month rows are the only series used for historical cross-metal ratios and performance in this artifact.
comparisons.alignment: Ratios use exact same-month intersections. No live Gold API value, USGS annual estimate, or VNXAU token value is spliced into IMF history.
comparisons.quoteRole: Gold API supplies an indicative current overlay for XAU, XAG, XPT, and XPD only.

methodology.unavailable: Missing quotes remain null and unavailable; zero and inferred substitutes are prohibited.
methodology.noExecution: No trading, order-routing, wallet, or transaction-action URL or hook is published.
